title: Termwise representatives give derived coproducts
statement: For every scheme X and family of complexes K_i with chosen isomorphisms Q(K_i) ≅ E_i, the cofan with vertex Q(∐ K_i) and legs E_i → Q(∐ K_i) given by e_i inverse followed by Q of the coprojection is a colimit in D(O_X).

proof.text: Module sheaves form a Grothendieck abelian category, and every derived target admits a K-injective representative J. Maps from the termwise sum to J are families of chain maps, and homotopies assemble degreewise as well. Hence the restriction bijection on homotopy classes proves the derived coproduct universal property. Transport its sources along the chosen e_i; empty and singleton families obey the same argument.

lean.statement:
theorem derivedAmbientDirectSumsCofan (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    (I : Type u) (E : I → schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (K : I → CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (e : ∀ i : I, DerivedCategory.Q.obj (K i) ≅ E i) :
    Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (∐ K))
      (fun i ↦ (e i).inv ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map (Sigma.ι K i))))
